name: gimp-mcp
description: GIMP MCP — FastMCP 3.2 SOTA: portmanteau tools, Agent Lab, fleet/sim-art pipelines, MCPB.

prompts.name: gimp_edit_session
prompts.description: Plan a safe GIMP editing session for a stated goal.
prompts.text: Plan a safe step-by-step GIMP session: 1) gimp_file validate/info, 2) gimp_transform geometry, 3) gimp_color levels first, 4) gimp_filter creative, 5) gimp_layer non-destructive, 6) gimp_analysis QC, 7) gimp_file export. Stay in allowed directories; never overwrite sources.

prompts.name: gimp_batch_folder_prep
prompts.description: Checklist for batch-processing a directory of images.
prompts.text: Batch checklist: list files under an allowed directory, gimp_batch resize/convert with explicit input/output directories, spot-check 1-2 samples with gimp_analysis, verify disk space before large runs.

prompts.name: gimp_color_grading_pass
prompts.description: Order of operations for a color grading pass.
prompts.text: Grade on a duplicate layer: gimp_color brightness_contrast (small moves), levels/curves (black/white points), hue_saturation, optional mild sharpen after resize, export via gimp_file convert.

prompts.name: gimp_agentic_sampling_hint
prompts.description: When to use server-side sampling vs client tool loops.
prompts.text: Use ctx.sample/gimp_agentic_workflow when the host supports MCP sampling and the server-side model should plan; use direct portmanteau tool loops when the client LLM orchestrates. Read skill://gimp-expert/SKILL.md for conventions.
